title: Protocol 23 upgrade ledger: LedgerCloseMeta v1 with header 23 and nine config-setting upgrade changes
why: The Protocol 23 upgrade ledger is still LedgerCloseMeta v1 with a sequential (v0) Soroban phase, although its header is 23; the parallel phase and LedgerCloseMeta v2 start one ledger later. Its upgrade updates three config settings and creates three new ones. Readers that switch to the v2 layout by header version misparse it.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger; header protocol 23, transactions applied under Protocol 22.

values.note: The Soroban phase is still v0 (sequential).

notes: 308 transactions applied under Protocol 22 (220 classic, 88 Soroban). Upgrade changes: live_soroban_state_size_window, contract_ledger_cost_v0 and state_archival updated (state + updated pairs); contract_ledger_cost_ext_v0, scp_timing and contract_parallel_compute_v0 created. The 88 Soroban transactions carry their fee refund as after_tx events, the pre-v2 form. The lake object was written by stellar-core 24.1.0 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time. The next ledger is protocol-23/first-lcm-v2-parallel-phase.
